content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Generic injectable and inhalation drug maker; it sells pharmaceuticals, not research tools or instruments."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sample storage and genomic sequencing services; it shares lab customers but not Bio-Rad's instrument, reagent and diagnostic business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Orthopedic devices and biologics sold to surgeons; no overlap with research tools or clinical diagnostics."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Clinical testing and drug trial services business; it runs labs for fees rather than selling instruments and reagents."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Radiopharmaceutical imaging agents and generators for hospitals; different products and end market from Bio-Rad."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Patient monitoring devices, sensors and wearables; medical devices rather than life science research tools or diagnostics."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sleep apnea and respiratory devices sold to patients and providers; a medical device business, not research or diagnostics."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Life science research instruments, reagents and diagnostic kits sold to the same labs and hospitals, direct and via distributors."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Medical and dental products plus health information software and coding services; different products and customers."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Contract sterilization and sterility testing service for device makers; does not sell research instruments or diagnostics."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Hospital medical devices such as catheters and surgical instruments; a different business from research tools and diagnostics."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Industrial coding printers and water quality instruments; shares some instrument selling but serves different customers and markets."}]}
